children.note: Gain space and chase the f6 knight.
Kick the c6 knight first; e5 falls next.
Black grabs the pawn. Now you gain time on the knights.
This is what c3 was for. Don’t defend e4: open the centre.
The most common reply. Black hits e4 at once.
Hit the bishop and grab the centre with tempo.
Take the centre anyway; Black is passive.
Pin the c6 knight. Bb5 next piles on.
Open the centre while Black’s king is loose.
The Ponziani. c3 prepares d4 and takes d4 away from the c6 knight.
